Description

The 2019 Nissan Rogue is a crossover with no particular character, and that is meant as praise: it surprises you with nothing, which is exactly what makes it easy. A settled ride, soft suspension, light steering, unhurried responses — a car you do not have to learn before setting off.

Inside it is noticeably roomier than it looks from outside, especially in the back: three adults travel properly on the second row rather than putting up with it. The boot is deep and squared off with a flat floor — two large suitcases and rucksacks go in without a game of Tetris.

The suspension is set up softly, and you feel that on broken asphalt, of which Adjara has plenty once you leave the main streets. Five seats, left-hand drive.

There is no deposit on this car. A good option for a family taking a car for a week or two who simply want to drive.
